content.description: Horizontal timeline on the dashboard showing the next 7 days of vessel arrivals and departures. Data comes from capVesselSchedules joined with capPortRotations. Each vessel schedule is rendered as a row with port rotation bars showing port-to-port segments. Color-coded by on-time (ETA vs actual arrival) status: green for on-time, amber for approaching, red for delayed. Click any vessel opens the vessel schedule detail. Positioned between the Booking Pipeline Funnel and the Activity Feed/Quick Actions grid.

data_sources.primary_table: capVesselSchedules — filtered by tenantId, status='active'|'published', validityFrom ≤ now+7d
data_sources.joined_table: capPortRotations — inner join on vesselScheduleId, filtered by arrivalEta or departureEtd within next 7 days
data_sources.query_strategy: Single query: SELECT schedule fields + port rotation fields FROM capPortRotations INNER JOIN capVesselSchedules ON vesselScheduleId, WHERE tenantId = tid AND schedule status in ('active','published') AND port rotation arrivalEta/departureEtd between now and now+7d, ORDER BY arrivalEta ASC. Group results client-side by vesselScheduleId.

timeline_design.layout: Horizontal timeline spanning 7 days. X-axis = date (today through today+6). Y-axis = vessel rows (one per active schedule with upcoming rotations).
timeline_design.vessel_row: Each row shows: vessel name (left label), service name, then horizontal bars for each port rotation within the 7-day window.
timeline_design.port_bar: Each port rotation renders as a small card/pill on the timeline at the appropriate date position. Shows portName, arrivalEta time, and a status dot (green/amber/red).

status_colors.on_time: emerald — actualArrival is null (future) OR actualArrival <= arrivalEta
status_colors.approaching: amber — arrivalEta is within next 24 hours and no actualArrival yet
status_colors.delayed: rose — actualArrival > arrivalEta, or arrivalEta has passed with no actualArrival
status_colors.departed: blue — actualDeparture is set (vessel has left this port)

timeline_design.empty_state: If no vessel schedules have port rotations in the next 7 days, show 'No vessel arrivals/departures in the next 7 days' with link to vessel schedules page.
timeline_design.max_vessels: Show up to 8 vessels. If more, show '+N more' link to the vessels hub.

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows a 'Vessel Schedule' section below the Booking Pipeline Funnel
Timeline displays port rotations (arrivals/departures) for the next 7 days from capPortRotations joined with capVesselSchedules
Each vessel schedule is a row showing vessel name, service name, and port rotation entries positioned by date
Port rotations are color-coded: emerald (on-time/future), amber (arriving within 24h), rose (delayed/overdue), blue (departed)
Status is determined by comparing arrivalEta vs actualArrival, and checking if departureEtd has passed
Timeline shows 7 day columns (today through today+6) with date labels
Each port rotation entry shows: port name, ETA time, status indicator dot
Maximum 8 vessel rows displayed; if more, show '+N more vessels' link to /vessels-hub
Empty state: 'No upcoming vessel movements' message with link to /vessels-hub
Clicking a vessel name navigates to /vessels-hub (vessel detail page when available)
Query includes tenantId filter and deletedAt IS NULL on both tables
Dark mode support on all elements
edge_cases: Zero vessel schedules — show empty state with helpful link
Schedule has port rotations but none in next 7 days — vessel not shown
Port rotation has arrivalEta but null departureEtd — show arrival only
Port rotation has null arrivalEta but set departureEtd — show departure only
Multiple port rotations on same day for same vessel — stack vertically within the row
Very long vessel names — truncate with ellipsis at ~20 chars
More than 8 vessels with upcoming rotations — show first 8 + overflow link
All rotations are in the past (stale data) — same as empty state
actualArrival set but actualDeparture null — vessel is currently at port (highlight as 'In Port')
Port rotation dates span beyond the 7-day window — clip to visible range
error_handling: Query failure — show 'Unable to load vessel schedule' message in the section, don't crash the dashboard
Auth failure — handled by parent page redirect (getSession check)
Null/undefined arrivalEta and departureEtd — skip that rotation entry (don't render)
Invalid date values — gracefully fallback to 'TBD' display
security_considerations: tenantId filter mandatory on both capVesselSchedules and capPortRotations queries
Read-only — no mutations from this component
No user input — no XSS or injection risk
content.implementation_notes: Add query index 19 and 20 to the Promise.allSettled array in src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx. Query: join capPortRotations with capVesselSchedules, filter by tenantId, schedule status in active/published, port rotation arrivalEta or departureEtd between now and now+7d. Import capVesselSchedules and capPortRotations from @/db/schema. Create a VesselScheduleTimeline client component at src/components/dashboard/vessel-schedule-timeline.tsx. Component receives an array of { vesselName, serviceName, portName, portCode, arrivalEta, departureEtd, actualArrival, actualDeparture, status } objects. Renders as a card matching the booking-pipeline.tsx style (rounded-xl border bg-white p-6 shadow-sm). Use a simplified list layout rather than a full Gantt chart — each vessel row shows its upcoming port calls as inline pills.
affected_files: src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx — import capVesselSchedules + capPortRotations, add join query, extract data, render VesselScheduleTimeline
testing_requirements: Timeline renders with correct vessel names and port rotations
Status colors apply correctly based on ETA vs actual arrival logic
Empty state renders when no upcoming vessel movements exist
Dark mode renders correctly on all elements
Max 8 vessels displayed with overflow indicator
Port rotation entries show correct date/time formatting
